notes:
### New

- **On grid, and what every state means.** A UPS on normal power now reads On grid. The ⓘ next to its state lists every state the app shows, with the current one marked.
- **Calmer charts.** Voltage, battery voltage and frequency show their normal range as a soft band, and the scales stay steady, so ordinary small wobbles no longer look alarming. A reading outside its normal range still stands out.
- **Your myTescom picture.** Your photo, or the icon and colour you picked in myTescom, now appears in the app.
- **Keep a UPS to its USB port.** In a UPS's Settings, link it to the USB port it is plugged into. Plugged into another port, it shows as Disconnected until you put it back or link the new port.
- **Screens that update on their own.** Small improvements to the app's screens now arrive without installing a new version.

### Improved

- **One account menu.** Your picture, name and email open My account. My devices is now Plan and activations, and each UPS's warranty and plan are also in its own Settings.
- **Simpler warranty.** Upload the invoice with a small link right under the warranty.
- **Plain words in diagnostics.** The diagnostics page says what happened to your UPS, such as "Grid down: running on battery", instead of technical messages.
- **Pages close with an X.** My account, Plan and activations and Preferences close with an X at the top right.
- **Faster Plan and activations.** It shows what it loaded last time straight away and refreshes in the background.
- **Clearer banners.** Updates in blue, things to do in amber, problems in red, with their buttons on the right.
- **Disconnected.** A UPS that doesn't answer now reads Disconnected.

### Fixed

- Turning on the cloud agent on a computer that had an earlier version of it could leave the new one unable to start.
- Charts keep their text at a normal size on a wide window.
